name: use-indexed-db
title: useIndexedDB
description: Options for configuring the IndexedDB connection and behavior.

tags.template: - The type of the data to be stored.

parameters.name: databaseName
parameters.description: - The name of the IndexedDB database.

parameters.name: storeName
parameters.description: - The name of the object store within the database.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Configuration options for the database connection (optional).

properties.name: version
properties.description: The version of the database. Changing this triggers an upgrade.

properties.name: onUpgradeNeeded
properties.type: ((db: IDBDatabase, oldVersion: number, newVersion: number) => void) | undefined
properties.description:
A callback function executed when the database version changes or is created.
Use this to create or modify object stores.

returnType.name: UseIndexedDBReturn<T>
returnType.description: An object containing the current data state, error state, loading state, and methods to interact with the database.

properties.name: data
properties.description: The most recently accessed or modified data item.

properties.name: error
properties.description: The error message if an operation failed, or null if successful.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Indicates if the database is initializing or an operation is in progress.

properties.name: setItem
properties.description: Stores a value in the database under the specified key.

properties.name: getItem
properties.description: Retrieves a value from the database by its key.

properties.name: removeItem
properties.description: Removes an item from the database by its key.

properties.name: clear
properties.description: Removes all items from the current object store.

properties.name: getAllKeys
properties.description: Retrieves all keys currently stored in the object store.
